name: Kim Kardashian
bio:
Kimberly Noel Kardashian is an American socialite, entrepreneur, and reality TV star. Born to Kris Jenner (previously Kristen Mary Houghton) and Robert Kardashian on 21st October, 1980. Her father Robert was the defence attorney for OJ Simpson.

Kim was Paris Hilton's assistant between 2003 to 2006. Following this, she gained media attention in 2007 following the unauthorized release of a sex tape with American singer Ray J.  Kim was married to former NBA Player Kris Humphreys for 72 days in 2011.

She was on the reality television show Keeping Up With the Kardashians, which ran for 20 seasons across 14 years.

She was previously married to Kanye West, with whom they share four children.
